action.details: Appends the trimmed selection after the existing clipboard text, separated by a new line. Hold Shift while clicking to prepend instead, or Option to use a space as the separator. If either side is empty, ActionClip avoids adding an unnecessary separator.
action.exampleOutput:
Clipboard becomes:
First research note
Second research note
action.name: Append to Clipboard
action.privacySummary: ActionClip reads and updates the macOS clipboard locally. The selection and clipboard contents never leave your Mac.
action.requirements: The selection must contain text. Hold Shift to prepend or Option to separate with a space.
action.summary: Combine selected text with the existing clipboard text.
